local kind,slot,hlevel="fire imp","MAINHAND",20
	local function checkSeed(o)
		if o.type == "seed" and o.subtype == "demon" and o.demon then
			print("Testing inferior demon", o.demon.name, o.demon.level, "against trying to make", kind, hlevel)
			if o.demon.name == kind and o.on_slot == slot then
				return true
			end
		end
	end
assert(checkSeed({type="seed",subtype="demon",demon={name="fire imp",level=10},on_slot="MAINHAND"}))
assert(not checkSeed({type="seed",subtype="demon",demon={name="fire imp",level=10},on_slot="BODY"}))
assert(not checkSeed({type="seed",subtype="demon",demon={name="quasit",level=10},on_slot="MAINHAND"}))
assert(not checkSeed({type="other",subtype="demon",demon={name="fire imp",level=10},on_slot="MAINHAND"}))
print("PASS 4 seed matching combinations")
